sample_unit: standardized periodontal complaint queries (each answered by four LLMs)

links.outcome: Patient Language Score (linguistic accessibility) of LLM responses to periodontal queries
links.effect: PLS scores were generally high across models, indicating good linguistic accessibility for patients; no significant differences between models in PLS (all p > 0.05).
links.quote: PLS scores were generally high across models, indicating good linguistic accessibility for patients.

unlisted_practices: Using an AI-based evaluator alongside blinded human reviewers to score LLM response quality (human-AI agreement ICC 0.911-0.925)

screen.reason: The study evaluates four LLMs on standardized periodontal complaint queries using an offline benchmark and expert review, without testing specific deployment practices or operational safeguards.
